question: Which materials are listed as suitable for the vessels addressed to the goddess?
premises: A vessel made of clay is named
A vessel born of tortoise is named
Vessels made of bell-metal and copper-metal are named
inference: Suitable vessels include those made of clay, tortoise, bell-metal, and copper-metal.
uncertainties: The exact referent of kūrmajaṃ may be a tortoise-shell vessel.
plain_english: O goddess, vessels made of clay, born of tortoise, made of bell-metal, and made of copper-metal.
